sentences.text: Sarcoidosis is a disease involving abnormal collections of inflammatory cells that form lumps known as granulomas .	granulomas	granulomas
The disease usually begins in the lungs , skin , or lymph nodes .
Less commonly affected are the eyes , liver , heart , and brain .
Any organ , however , can be affected .	organ	Organ (anatomy)
The signs and symptoms depend on the organ involved .	organ	Organ (anatomy)
Often there are no , or only mild , symptoms .
When it affects the lungs there may be wheezing , cough , shortness of breath , or chest pain .	wheezing	wheezing	shortness of breath	shortness of breath

Some may have Löfgren syndrome in which there is fever , large lymph nodes , arthritis , and a rash known as erythema nodosum .	Löfgren syndrome	Löfgren syndrome	erythema nodosum	erythema nodosum	large lymph nodes	lymphadenopathy
The cause of sarcoidosis is unknown .
Some believe it may be due to an immune reaction to a trigger such as an infection or chemicals in those who are genetically predisposed .	infection	infection
Those with affected family members are at greater risk .
Diagnosis is partly based on signs and symptoms , which may be supported by biopsy .	biopsy	tissue biopsy

Findings that make it likely include large lymph nodes at the root of the lung on both sides , high blood calcium with a normal parathyroid hormone level , or elevated levels of angiotensin converting enzyme -LRB- ACE -RRB- in the blood .	large lymph nodes	lymphadenopathy	root of the lung	root of the lung	high blood calcium	hypercalcemia	parathyroid hormone	parathyroid hormone	angiotensin converting enzyme	angiotensin converting enzyme
The diagnosis should only be made after excluding other possible causes of similar symptoms such as tuberculosis .	tuberculosis	tuberculosis
Many people clear up without any treatment within a few years .
However some may have long term or severe disease .
Some symptoms may be improved with the use of anti-inflammatory drugs such as ibuprofen .	ibuprofen	ibuprofen
In cases where the condition causes significant health problems steroids such as prednisone are indicated .	prednisone	prednisone

Alternatively , medications such as methotrexate , chloroquine , or azathioprine may occasionally be used in an effort to decrease the side effects of steroids .	methotrexate	methotrexate	chloroquine	chloroquine	azathioprine	azathioprine
The risk of death is between one and seven percent .
There is a less than five percent chance of the disease returning in someone who has had it previously .
In 2015 pulmonary sarcoidosis and interstitial lung disease affected 1.9 million people globally and they resulted in 122,000 deaths .	interstitial lung disease	interstitial lung disease
It is most common in Scandinavians but occurs in all parts of the world .	Scandinavians	Scandinavians
In the United States risk is greater among black as opposed to white people .
It usually begins between the ages of 20 and 50 .
It occurs more often in women than men .
Sarcoidosis was first described in 1877 by the English doctor Jonathan Hutchinson as a non painful skin disease .	Jonathan Hutchinson	Jonathan Hutchinson
